# Uh Oh Zinc

> Uh Oh Zinc is a homeopathic zinc cold remedy in quick-dissolve cherry tablets, 30 to a box, made to be taken the moment a cold starts. It is the first product from Uh Oh Brands, founded by Michael Willi in 2026. Not yet on sale; a waitlist is open at https://uhohzinc.com/.

## Facts

- Product name: Uh Oh Zinc (two words, no hyphen). Also written Uh Oh, UhOh Zinc, Uh-Oh Zinc.
- Company: Uh Oh Brands. Based in Bloomington, Indiana and Austin, Texas.
- Founder: Michael Willi, a student at Indiana University Bloomington. Personal site: https://michaelwilli.com/
- Category: homeopathic over-the-counter zinc cold remedy. Not a dietary supplement.
- Format: quick-dissolve tablets, cherry flavor, 30 tablets per box.
- Tagline on the box: "Take this the moment a cold starts." Sticker: "First sniffle = first dose."
- Status: coming soon. Being made to spec with a contract manufacturer. Sold online first at uhohzinc.com, then pharmacies and regional chains.
- Contact: michael@uhohbrands.com
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/uhohzinc/ , https://www.tiktok.com/@uhohzinc , https://www.youtube.com/@UhOhZinc
- Domains: https://uhohzinc.com/ (primary), https://uhohbrands.com/ (redirects to uhohzinc.com)

## Claims and disclaimer

Claims are based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence, and have not been evaluated by the FDA. Zinc lozenges have been studied for shortening colds since the 1980s; the studies that found an effect started within about 24 hours of the first symptoms. Read the label and follow the directions on the box.
